lines.text: باب هشتم در بیان درجات مذکر و مؤنث از بروج فایده این باب انست که اگر
lines.en: Chapter Eight: On explaining the masculine and feminine degrees of the zodiac signs. The benefit of this chapter is that if

lines.text: کسی مسئله از جهت مردی پرسد و طالع وقت در برجی مذکر باشد بقوت
lines.en: someone asks a question concerning a man, and the ascendant of the time is in a masculine sign, it will be strong;

lines.text: تر باشد و اگر مسئله از بهر زنی پرسد و طالع وقت در جی ماده باشد
lines.en: and if the question is asked concerning a woman, and the ascendant of the time is in a female sign,

lines.text: مسئله را قوت دهد درجات اینست
lines.en: it gives strength to the question. The degrees are these:

lines.text: حمل | ثور | جوزا | سرطان | اسد | سنبله | میزان | عقرب | قوس | جدی | دلو | حوت
lines.en: Aries | Taurus | Gemini | Cancer | Leo | Virgo | Libra | Scorpio | Sagittarius | Capricorn | Aquarius | Pisces

summary.headline: Masculine and Feminine Zodiac Degrees
summary.text: Chapter Eight explains masculine and feminine zodiac degrees and their use in judging questions about men and women according to the ascendant’s sign. A table assigns alternating masculine and feminine classifications across Aries through Pisces.
